I didn't submit the model. My web search allowance ran out partway through the research, and the submission validator won't accept a model with missing market caps. A model built from what I have would also break your rule against empty peer figures.

**What I have (USD millions, FY2025, from stockanalysis.com pages; I did not open the 10-K or earnings-release tables):**

| Company | Revenue | EBITDA | Net income | Net debt (excl. leases) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Merck (MRK, target) | 65,011 | 29,105 | 18,254 | 34,774 |
| Pfizer (PFE) | 62,579 | not found | 7,771 | 51,430 |
| Eli Lilly (LLY) | 65,179 | not found | 20,640 | 35,235 |

- **Merck revenue:** Merck's own 8-K Exhibit 99.1 (accession 0001104659-26-009495) confirms full-year sales of $65.0B.
